verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs name a built-in agent that marketers can use in natural language to explore segments and analyze campaign performance. They also say marketers review and refine the agents' work before anything launches. Evidence for the in-product assistant is a single thin line with limited stated scope. The richer task delegation (building audiences, managing syncs, generating ads) is documented only through the MCP server for external assistants, which does not count as built-in. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-product assistant's task scope and actions, evidence it can execute tasks such as building audiences or syncs inside the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language
